source-support-sourcespans.definition: collection of selected span records attached to one support relation; a template placeholder is not a populated selection.
source-support-sourcespans.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items.definition: one selected source-span record, distinct from its support root and from a locator address.
source-support-sourcespans-items.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-checksu.definition: narrative note that points to recorded hashes or edition identity; it is not itself a checksum.
source-support-sourcespans-items-checksu.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-content.definition: retained quotation or paraphrase/description of selected material; all four pilots explicitly describe paraphrases.
source-support-sourcespans-items-content.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-context.definition: qualifying context around selected material, including citation and figure limits; it is neither the asserted subject nor a verdict.
source-support-sourcespans-items-context.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: collection of locator references for the selected span.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: one locator reference; text and figure locators can be jointly selected without making the figure independent proof.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: identifier of a locator target, used with path and revision rather than as a globally unique address.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: relative record path and optional anchor locating a locator target; resolution alone is not support.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.definition: revision of a locator target; pilots use numeric 1, a local convention rather than a universal type.
source-support-sourcespans-items-locator.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-quotepo.definition: policy distinguishing retained quotation from paraphrase; no quotation retained is neither permission nor fidelity proof.
source-support-sourcespans-items-quotepo.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-selecti.definition: declared narrower material selected from locator context, such as inclusive lines plus a figure; different breadth is not an error.
source-support-sourcespans-items-selecti.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.definition: reference to the source identity/acquisition record, distinct from snapshot and locator.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.definition: identifier of the source record; pilots use ccn-book, not a claim or span ID.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.definition: path to the source-acquisition record; it resolves relative to a pilot but does not itself establish immutable bytes.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.definition: source-record capture token; pilots use commit-like e0c697b4 while locator and prepared revisions are numeric.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sourcer.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.definition: reference to the prepared snapshot record bounding the inspected representation, distinct from source identity.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.definition: prepared snapshot identifier ps-ccn-book-pilot-20260911 linking a span to its manifest.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.definition: path to a prepared-source manifest; it records upstream provenance, not semantic support alone.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.definition: prepared snapshot record revision; pilot numeric 1 does not by itself prove immutable bytes.
source-support-sourcespans-items-sources.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcespans-items-spanid.definition: local identifier for a selected span; no global uniqueness rule is established.
source-support-sourcespans-items-spanid.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-sourcesupportstatus.definition: observed assertion-to-span relation label: template unassessed; pilots candidate-supported or candidate-supported-with-caveat. It is not verification, grade, or an exhaustive vocabulary.
source-support-sourcesupportstatus.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-subjectref.definition: reference to the assertion evaluated by support; pilots identify claims, while template conventions also permit an edge or identifiable CQ coverage assertion.
source-support-subjectref.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-subjectref-id.definition: identifier of the asserted subject, distinct from support root and span IDs; pilot values are claim-* IDs.
source-support-subjectref-id.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-subjectref-path.definition: path and anchor locating the subject declaration; it requires agreement with identifier, type, and revision.
source-support-subjectref-path.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-subjectref-recordtype.definition: construct type of the subject; pilots use claim and synthetic conventions illustrate edge/CQ roles.
source-support-subjectref-recordtype.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.

source-support-subjectref-revision.definition: revision of the asserted subject; pilots use numeric 1, a local reference convention rather than a universal datatype.
source-support-subjectref-revision.disposition: Preserve this field's observed value/shape and its stated boundary; do not turn path resolution, preparation provenance, or a relation label into independent verification or admission.
